# InfraPhysics

> Personal lab, notebook, and knowledge graph by Yago Mendoza -- industrial engineer and systems builder.

## About

Yago Mendoza is an industrial engineer who bridges hardware and software. He writes about machine learning infrastructure, distributed systems, scaling laws, AI alignment, and cross-domain pattern recognition. His work emphasizes that engineering principles transfer across substrates -- supply chains and data pipelines follow the same optimization patterns.

Tagline: "From systems to atoms and back. Engineering is engineering. The substrate doesn't matter."

## Site Structure

- /home -- Landing page and navigation hub
- /about -- Background, beliefs, and expertise areas
- /lab/projects -- Engineering projects with technical deep-dives
- /lab/second-brain -- Knowledge graph of 434+ interconnected concept notes
- /lab/second-brain/graph -- Visual graph explorer
- /blog/threads -- Long-form essays on technology, AI, economics, and systems thinking
- /blog/bits2bricks -- Technical tutorials bridging software and physical engineering

## Projects

- [Infraphysics — building a website that thinks](https://infraphysics.net/lab/projects/infraphysics-web): How a systems engineer built a personal site with a custom markdown compiler, a second brain, and an AI development partner — and what went wrong along the way.
- [FinBoard — a personal finance dashboard that shouldn't exist](https://infraphysics.net/lab/projects/finboard): A vanilla JS investment dashboard built in one session with Claude 4.6. No framework, no build step, no npm install. Just a folder you double-click.

## Threads (Essays)

- [Trabajar con IA engancha.](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/2387542): Dopamina, backlog, y un ciclo de recompensa que no para.
- [We Solved Alignment. For Paperclips.](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/3392058): Goodhart's law, reward hacking, and the optimizer you already are.
- [Caparazón de silicio](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/7270022): Presiones evolutivas, capital, y un animal que no para de crecer.
- [I've spent years trying not to lose myself and I almost pulled it off.](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/2929333): Obsidian, Notion, Anki, and the archive that might actually pay off.
- [Why nobody actually understands AI (and how to fix that in one thread)](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/6029417): Nodes, weights, training — and the intuition gap that makes people say nonsense.
- [The brain can't do backpropagation. So what is it doing?](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/8305244): Backpropagation, Hebbian plasticity, and a fundamental mismatch.
- [The Bitter Lesson](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/9150483): Computación bruta, diseño humano, y setenta años de lecciones ignoradas.
- [15.4%](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/9962668): Scheming benchmarks, chain-of-thought opacity, and a number going up.
- [Every time we think we've found the ceiling, the ceiling leaves.](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/6616933): Prediction, acceleration, and a ceiling that keeps leaving.
- [Everybody has an opinion on AI](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/1147290): Hype, uninformed takes, and the real AI bubble.
- [OpenClaw and the keys to your kingdom](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/5528103): AI agents, system access, and a trademark claim that backfired.
- [Alignment is not a vibe check](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/8888777): Interpretability, RLHF, and a safety problem with no clean edges.
- [why rust exists](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/4419076): Ownership, borrowing, and the compiler that won't let you cheat.
- [Everything is a pipe](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/7733621): Aqueducts, bloodstreams, TCP/IP. Same pattern, same solution.
- [Is there a wall for AI?](https://infraphysics.net/blog/threads/3841205): Attention, scaling laws, and an architecture that won't plateau.

## Bits2Bricks (Tutorials)

- [How LLMs learn](https://infraphysics.net/blog/bits2bricks/training-llms): A ground-up explanation of how language models are trained after pretraining — SFT, DPO, RL, RLHF, reward hacking, KL divergence, and the DeepSeek-R1 pipeline.
- [Transformers from scratch](https://infraphysics.net/blog/bits2bricks/transformers-from-scratch): A patient, ground-up explanation of transformer architecture — how tokens become predictions, what attention really computes, where facts live, and why it all scales.
- [OpenClaw containment playbook](https://infraphysics.net/blog/bits2bricks/openclaw-containment-playbook): Step-by-step guide to running OpenClaw safely using containers, VMs, network segmentation, and cloud deployment. Every technique ranked by effort and protection.
- [custom syntax pcb](https://infraphysics.net/blog/bits2bricks/custom-syntax-pcb): bridging markup syntax and hardware notation.

## Second Brain (Knowledge Graph)

434+ atomic concept notes covering machine learning, hardware architecture, blockchain, distributed systems, and optimization. Each note is one concept with bidirectional wiki-links. The graph reveals structural relationships between domains. Explorable at /lab/second-brain and /lab/second-brain/graph.
